description: Shaped like the kanji 山 — a horizontal connecting bar at Z≈13 spans X ∈ [-19, 22], with three vertical arms running south (decreasing Z): the LEFT arm at X≈-18 leads to the switch at (-19.2, -18.6); the MIDDLE arm at X≈-2 leads to the south portal at (-1.89, -22.88); the RIGHT arm at X≈14 leads to a dead-end interior. The hollows between arms are visual mesh — the player cannot walk through them. To move between arms the autopilot MUST traverse the top connecting bar.

portals.east: spawn_east at (22.86, 13.0) — at the east end of the horizontal top bar
portals.south_middle: load_north (south portal) at (-1.89, -22.88) — at the south end of the middle vertical arm; fenced until switch_c is hit

switch_c.description: South end of the LEFT vertical arm. Opens fence_c when hit.

fence_c.description: Blocks the middle arm just north of where the player would walk to reach the south portal.

anchors.description: west end of the horizontal top bar; joins the LEFT vertical arm (matches wp_1780239557900_qkivh7)
middle of the top bar; joins the MIDDLE vertical arm (matches wp_1780239568133_gncmrp)
east end of the top bar before it meets spawn_east; joins the RIGHT vertical arm (matches wp_1780256565400_6t3jh4)
south end of LEFT arm, at switch_c (matches wp_1780239564449_wwz2vc)
south end of RIGHT arm — dead-end interior (matches wp_1780256562749_4vm6jv)

traversalNotes: Stages are never physically rotated. cell.rotation is a gate-label swap only — all positions here are stage-local mesh-space XZ.

山 shape: three vertical arms (LEFT, MIDDLE, RIGHT) running south from a horizontal connecting bar at Z≈13. To move between arms, traverse the top bar — the inter-arm hollows are visual mesh that's not walkable.
Switch route: spawn_east → top_bar_east → top_bar_middle → top_bar_west → left_arm_south (switch_c).
Post-switch route to south portal: left_arm_south → top_bar_west → top_bar_middle → middle_arm_south (= spawn_north area, through opened fence_c → load_north).
Fence_c at (-2.2, 8) blocks the middle arm — only relevant after the switch is hit, when the autopilot needs to walk south down the middle arm to load_north.
